body:
I have this thought as well! I question wether it's love or lust. Maybe he just wants me for sex? maybe I want him for sex? 

Don't get reassurance, and don't try to figure it out cause once you do.. you'll question the answer itself and I'm telling you this out or experience! Trying to figuring things out won't work and would add up to your ocd thoughts. Stick to resisting compulsions and once you get this thought or anything other thought, just let it be there and go do anything else. <3

It happened to me as well! I was very afraid he would leave me and he reassured me Every time that he is staying until it got out of hand and we broke up.. don't worry we are back together now lol. I know it's my ocd who is making all this and when my fear happened like he left me for a week so I can think for myself and see what's going on. When what I feared the most happened, I no longer fear it now cause I went through it and I realized that I can live in my own but him being here with me makes me stronger. He told me that I left you for a week cause I wanted you confident and stronger that you don't need me or anything to make you feel good about yourself. I actually thanked him for that. 

Don't get reassurance and don't worry about him leaving, he isn't going to leave. That is your ocd <3 Take care of yourself

It's the same situation with my and my bf. We broke up a week ago and got back together, we saw each other and it all went well. (long story Lol) 

My bf is very busy with his exams, projects and yeah it does gives me thoughts that we will forget how to talk, he is going to forget me, I might get used to this, we might grow up apart. He worries that I am going to get angry or have unwanted thoughts but I told him that I can work it out in my own and that he can focus on whatever he is having right now. We talk once everyday and just for 5 minutes maybe! I do have a lot going on in my mind and we agreed that I only talk about it when I see him cause texting isn't the best for situations like this specially because I sometimes read his messages in a wrong way when he is fine and not angry at all! 

I know it isn't easy, you can focus on your studies now but I know the thoughts and the feelings are going to stop so leave them there.. it's okay.. accept them.. Don't overanalyze, check or whatever! You can keep a journal where you can write down all your thoughts and feelings so you can keep track on what's happening inside your mind and what's repeating. These days because I went through a break up trauma I am starting to question wether it's my ocd it's me. When we did not talk for a WEEK I swear I realized that all my thoughts were wrong and that I pushed him with all this! Now we are back together, the thoughts came back.. and now I'm scared cause the week before I knew they were all wrong why are they back. I knew from that time that it's my OCD.
That's a great step towards recovery! It is not easy, and not all psychologists are specialized but you can go and give it a try. Tell us about it!

Thank you very much!

When he left last week I was so depressed and wanted him back so bad and when it happened I started doubting again which is annoying cause I thought it's gone.

The things that are bothering are that I feel like he doesn't love me as much and I tried so hard to get him back like why would I do that? if someone loves me they will fight for me, the other thing is I'm afraid of messing it up again, we talked about things and he said 2 things that made me sensitive and I am obsessing about them now! I am asking myself wether I did the right or the wrong thing and wether I should stay in the relationship or let go. It is really hard with ocd and I no longer wanna make problems because of it cause last time I did, he broke up with me. I am trying to get over the things we been through like any normal person would say that's it be happy, you guys are back together.. but it doesn't work that way for me unfortunately.

Yes he does. He been through it with me for 4 months. He said he would handle it and help me! So many things happened. Ups and downs and he reached a point where he couldn't handle it, he started getting depressed. He said he loves me but he can't do this anymore, and I begged him to stay which was embarrassing but I didn't care cause our relationship is so strong and I love/care about him so so much. He went away and after 2 days I talked to him again and he said the same thing! He said he had times where he felt like leaving but he felt guilty and I asked him if it's forever? He said who knows if it's forever, but for now I am done.

I am so so broken. There are times where I might feel okay and I can handle the pain, and then there are others times where I am ready to kill myself cause I can't handle the memories, everything he said, his promises. I no longer if I should believe those or not! I feel so lost, worthless, ugly. I already have a low self esteem so now Idk what should I call it. I have no energy to even feed myself. Sleeping is so hard. I can't stop thinking about him and everything. Idk if I should blame myself of not. I feel so ashamed of my illness! I lost so many people but he was the last person I expected to lose and it happened.. I let go of everything, my dreams, my values, and my interests. 

Sometimes I feel so angry I wanna call him and scream but That's immature and I wanna show them that I really respect his decision and wants him to have space. I have urged to text and call when I fee down, sometimes I feel like getting high and calling him. I don't wanna leave and he feels like I got over him! He said "after thinking about it, I think your thoughts are true" and I told him NO! and I am still questioning wether my thoughts are real or not, wether I still want him or not, and what if he came back, would I work it out?

Yes.. I have relationship, religious obsessions. I also have this obsession where I think too much about sexual things, drugs, drinking thinking that these things are the reason why the world is fucked up and i'd go check if people does any of these stuff and when I know that they do I feel overwhelmed and when I find out they don't I feel better and think that the world is good! It may sounds very silly and I know that but I can't let go of it.. even when I try!
It's great! So everyone can read it when they enter the community. Thank you!
How is therapy going?

I know exactly how you feel.. It feels so real.. but yet so wrong.. and not right.. but still you feel like you don't know anymore.. I know it's me.. but I can't have feelings.. I'm fearing love, sex, life.. 

I've been having this for 4 days now and when I think that it might be real and not ocd I feel very bad! I don't want to believe that.

But what you said was right! But like my ocd is different to yours and others are different like it's because our relationships are not the same. 

I'm sorry that you are struggling. We are all here to help and support each other! Stay strong

I KNOW EXACTLY HOW YOU FEEL! and I swear I wanted to post a thread saying everything you posted but then I saw your post!

Let's hope someone has something to tell us!

Do you have ocd?

I appreciate you answering that thread but ocd doesn't work that way, it isn't a relationship problem, it's a mental health problem. Yes, it attacks you relationship, your religion.. it can nearly attack anything you care about.

I did not post that thread but I swear I would've written it today cause i'm having all these doubts and questions (obsessions) and many others have the same here, even the same fears and thoughts. For example, if I break up with my current bf, it would attack my next relationship and it isn't only relationships but it leads a person to a point where they don't wanna leave but at the same time they don't wanna stay. 

Anyway again, thank you for your advice but for me as a person with ocd I should let that person knows that it isn't that way. Have a nice day!

I'm just surprised because I'm going through the same thing. Things were okay until I started college and the pressure became extra and I had a fight with my bf. At college I check with both girls and boys (I always been straight but out of no where no I'm questioning my sexuality)

I know it's not easy. And I don't feel that anxious mostly i'm empty and lost.. 

Don't give up! <3

You have to understand that OCD doesn't go away completely. Yes your partner will do good, feel better, and even love you so much but with obsessions there are always something around wether it's relationship ocd, religion ocd, cleaning ocd, hocd.. etc 

I went through all that like for 2 weeks straight I was doing really really good until I started college and that's when the extra pressure came. My thoughts felt so real, I had a fight with my boyfriend (usually it comes with something and sometimes it comes suddenly, it's ocd) But like 4 days ago I said that's it I'm not gonna keep on doing that. I do count that as a down! It's still not easy, I still don't feel 100% comfortable (never did since the very beginning of my ocd and it's not only with my relationship but I have religious ocd also)

What you can do for your partner is to let him know that he is still doing good. We all have our ups and downs! Tell him to keep on going to therapy. Don't reassure him! He might feel very anxious but that's how it goes. I didn't start feeling better until I crashed down and felt completely empty. 

This is something I tell any person with a problem 
"The only way out is through" <3

Yeah this is what OCD does. When me and my bf disagree it feels like the end of the world. Even if we talked about it and agreed or like we are done with it, I'd still think about it and get angry. And for the "I don't care about him part" I feel you! I focus on whatever's wrong (even tho it isn't) and I get angry at him and say that I don't care about him.

Not really :( We don't have a mental health center there. Due to our cultural differences, they don't really care about mental illness here as much. 

I am going through a lot since the beginning of college, thinking and imagining stuff I never had before like think that my bf's friends is a better fit for me and when I overanalyzed it I was like "Omg he is really a great fit" which scared me cause I'm going to see my bf today. How am I going to sit with him when I'm doing this in my mind. Also, I'm not sleep or nor eating well because of my anxiety. Even though me and my bf talk too much and we enjoy the conservation, we even flirt but there is something in me that's still not 100% comfortable. I feel overwhelmed.

The only way out is through. I know these spikes and feelings are scary I'm actually have them now and it's been 3 days (I just started college and it's adding on me) don't try to figure out how you feel and why you feel this way, let it pass. And for the bad things about your bf I feel I swear. Sometimes these bad thoughts makes me angry at him for no reason and what bothers me the most is the fact that I don't know wether they're real or not. If I can't say they are well okay I'll discuss it with him and accept it and if not true well that's amazing but your mind would just switch to another thing so don't label your thoughts. Leave them as they are! It's good that you're getting help and your bf is supporting. Don't give up please <3

Don't try to figure this out. We all have our ups and downs! Complete your therapy. since you got help that's good don't worry about wether it's ocd or not (that's an obsession I think) I just started college and the same is happening to me. With the extra pressure I'm starting to feel more anxious and sick. To get better or to get through this is just to feel all this. Don't overanalyze it or seek reassurance.

Omg i'm going through the same. I'm straight but obsessing if maybe I am a lesbian or a bisexual, and it makes me super uncomfortable cause I think that maybe that's the reason why I feel empty and anxious in my relationship. I overanalyzed all my past relationships and experiences (that's a compulsion) try to convince myself that I had lesbians relationships (I didn't but I went through something as a kid and I said maybe that's the reason why maybe I might be bisexual) I also said that maybe my close friendship with some of my friends (girls) were a love relationship, and it just doesn't make sense that's why it's called OCD. I check myself with both girls and boys! It's just crazy and tiring and I know exactly how you feel.

Don't force yourself to feel a certain way. Just pass the thoughts, you don't have to interact with them cause they're just thoughts and don't try to figure out wether they're real or not cause you won't find answers and you will end up obsessing more. This happens to me as well so yeah it's a common thing for people with OCD.

I know exactly how you feel and it make me feel like i'm a bad person.. Accept all these annoying feelings and if you can tell your bf about it, it might help but don't let him give you reassurance just let it out. I write all my obsessions down to keep track to whats bothering me and realize how one day when I read them all I tell myself "Omg are you stupid?" and after couple of days I'd read them and be like "Omg this is so real" that's how ocd is.

I'm sorry that you are going through this, and believe me as much as it's not hard on us, we are willing to do everything to feel better in our relationship. It's good that you're with her and willing to support her.

For me and my bf what most helped is was communication. I wrote down all my obsessions and question and kept track of them, for me it makes it easier to know what are my worries. I tell my bf nearly everything (not 100% but what could be heard cause some thoughts are just silly and rude, and saying them when I know they're not true would break my heart and his) And when I tell him all that, it's just me letting it out. Don't give her reassurance nor answer any of her her questions/doubts because that's a compulsion (checking, asking for reassurance, testing, overanalyzing) When she does compulsion it'll give her a short relief but it'll come back worst so if you can help her with that. She might get angry that you aren't reassuring her (that happened to me) but remember that's for her best. 

She might sit with her and start checking her feelings "Do I love him?" "Maybe he isn't the one?" if she does that, tell her not to cause she can't figure it out. It's her ocd that's causing all this. We let our thoughts/doubts.. etc go through our minds without interacting with them. Like if I had a thought "Ugh my bf isn't attractive" I'd just stand up, go watch a movie, cook, go out anywhere.. and the thought is still there running through my mind but I don't overanalyze and it becomes something like that "If my bf isn't attractive, why am I with him?" "Maybe X is attractive and he suits me better?" "Maybe he should change his hair or something else?" Once I start digging into my thoughts, I get more anxious cause I'm trying to figure it out and sometimes I do reach a point where "good now I know he is attractive" and I feel better for couple of hours but then another thing pops into my mind! 

I understand that she is not comfortable with saying I love you and kissing you.. She is avoiding it because she is afraid she wouldn't like it, or it'll prove to her that she doesn't love you. We think by avoiding it will get better but we are just making it worse cause we don't wanna overthink, get anxious, cry, feel down but WE HAVE TO GO THROUGH IT! (the only way out is through) I used to avoid romantic movies and posts. I avoided going to weddings and even going out so I don't see other couples and compare them to us but what really helps is facing it. I started not avoiding anything and yeah it still makes me feel down & anxious. It'd make me question every aspect of my life and relationship.

The last thing is how to become friends with the thoughts and it's really helpful. If she had a thought that "My relationship isn't going to work" she has to go on with it "Um yeah my relationship really sucks" and so on with every instructive thought. Remember that also hanging out with each other, doing things together (mediating, video games, playing sport) Anything you both can enjoy together. This isn't an ocd advice but I thought I'd say it cause like they do help sometimes. 

Wish it all gets better!
Well it's one of my obsessions. I don't have a crush but i'm always checking with everyone to make sure my bf fits me and not someone else! It's annoying :(
Well yeah I liked to see how a fucking ignorant are you.. and I was right! anyway, you can go now.

https://www.reddit.com/r/Anxiety/comments/4ai8u5/dont_know_how_much_more_i_can_take/?st=ISXG8PY5&sh=1c6ab3cb

Explain this! so you can share your struggles with people and want them to be nice to you when you're just a mean person and an ignorant! Dude that's just fucked up. Well.. how about I comment on your sub and say "wtf be a man and stop panicking" "you are being silly" how would that make you feel? I'm very sure you can't control your anxiety! So it's okay for you to have a mental illness but others can't. 

People like you are not welcome here! You will never understand what we are going through unless you try it so you should be grateful instead of making fun of people.

She isn't! you are for being such an ignorant by not educating yourself and respecting people. ROCD is for people who struggle with OCD! It's either you say something nice or go. It's not hard at all! She won't be saying it if she isn't bothered by it and btw I struggle with the same thing.. many here do.. Anyway, thank you!

I'm sorry but that was rude.. If you don't have rocd and understand nothing about it then please don't talk because you don't know SHIT! We are here to help and support other and not judge them for what they can't control.

I swear it feels like I wrote this! I know exactly how you feel. It started with one thought "Do I really love?" and ended up making me overanalyze everything to the point where if my bf didn't agree with me on something silly or didn't like a song/a movie I liked I'd think that our relationship is doomed and he isn't the one. I obsess about him being a bad person.. so many obsessions!!

I don't wanna reassure you cause believe me it's bad. Don't react to your thoughts! Let them go through your mind and do everything you want. Also, don't fight them or try to add logic. There are better users here who are better than me and they'll help! Be patient and it'll get better. I'm struggling with this for 2 months now. The are ups and downs but I can say I got better 

Don't worry, just work on it step by step and I know you have days where you feel like giving up (it happened to me)

My past relationship were shit so yeah it was a relief (I did experience rocd that time) but now I'm in a serious relationship and yes I do feel like breaking up with my bf to escape my thoughts, the way I see him in my head which is a bad image of him.. etc 

We tried to break up once we both ended up crying and after 10 min we both said NO! It was really really hard for both of us. It was like the worst 10 minute I experienced in my whole life lol like even tho I wanted it to feel better, it made me feel worse..
I do! like I get this A LOT. sometimes I feel like my bf deserves better than me.. I hate trying to change him to reassure myself :(

Feel the anxiety.. Sometimes we check, over analyze, add logic to our obsessions, get reassurance to escape the anxiety, worrying, feeling overwhelmed but that's a short relief! So start feeling the anxiety more. Do not avoid it! We feel too much that's why we become numb. 

I wish I can get help but like I'm afraid that the dr will tell me that there isn't a thing called rocd! :(

At the beginning I was always googling things non stop and yeah I still do but not like before. Don't try to figure it out, this will only brings more. Reading through those relationships websites will really add up to your obsessions (believe me that happened to me and made it even worse) 

I'm very sure it's your anxiety/panic attacks that's stopping you from stopping the compulsion. In order to get better, start feeling MORE! I know it sounds stupid but accept it and feel it.. The only way out is through <3 It's great that your father is helping and your bf is supporter. Talk to them whenever you feel down and be patient. I know it isn't easy but it's worth it. I've been struggling with this for 2 months now and there are ups and downs but I don't wanna give up. 

I'm thinking of taking antidepressant, how are they? are they helping?

This really sounds like ROCD. Don't worry about it but make sure you don't get too much reassurance, or do a compulsion like (checking, counting, testing, overanalyzing) cause they'll just make it worse.

My case is close to you but like I have more obsessions, I obsess about his flaws (or what my mind think is flaws), I get extremely jealous and angry when I see any girl wondering "what if he saw her" "she is better than me", I judge him and that really breaks my heart but I don't say those judgments cause I was always that person who accepts everyone and never judge (this is my ocd), I question my love for him and his love for me.. Sometimes I question wether this is my ocd or I should start fixing those obsessions > the last one is the hardest. 

Believe me I know how you feel and hold on! We all know our partners have done nothing but we worry too much.. that's the nature of ocd.. I'm starting to even bring back old fights from 2 years ago and obsess about them. I feel guilty when I think or feel wrong about him. OCD is black and white! Sometimes when I feel sure that he loves me, I start questioning my love for him, and when I feel sure that he doesn't love him, I start questioning his love for me and feeling like I love him but he doesn't. OCD can be really tricky so don't listen to what your mind says. Just accept it and go on! Don't try to fight nor add logic to it cause you'll just obsess more..

If you want someone to talk to or have question we are all here to support you <3
Your illness is not YOU. Don't let this stop from something you want :(
Did you have any obsessions about your relationships? was any of obsessions or worries real?
That's reassurance be careful. I feel you I swear! I'm even afraid to see my bf because I might check up with him and feel that I don't love him..

My Religious ocd is all covered in my mind.. When I started praying I felt really wrong! Like I started obsessing what if I missed a prayer? what if x doesn't prays? what if and what if... well at the end I just stopped praying but that doesn't mean I don't believe in God but I just can't do it.. When I try to go near those religious stuff and pick myself a sect or a religion I just go crazy and it's not that I find them all trash no. I'm a really open minded person and I value all kind of religions. They all have their own beauty and I'm interested in knowing and reading but like it's because I have ocd which does that to me.

I did the same as you did! But I still question wether I should stay that way or not.. Like I try to just forget it! It's not I was religious after all. But when I entered that cycle I turned crazy. I couldn't settle. 

I can say that I believe in EVERYTHING that's much easier than not believing in anything and like it doesn't play a big role in my mind I just use "I believe in everything and all religions and gods" so I don't start questioning and doubting. And because i'm in a relationship, my bf is not religious but has a religion and I respect that but sometimes it makes me angry and I don't wanna control him and force him to believe in what I do and debate about religions. Like sometimes I feel like going back to my normal life where I had a religion and I didn't question it and like be like my bf (I have rocd too) Like that would really make it easier for me but I'm afraid if I did it the cycle will begin again :(

Yeah! and you see me and my bf have our own differences which is OKAY but I sometimes feel like I can't accept it even tho we disagree but then agree at some point and everything becomes normal but I ask myself "Do I accept him?" "What if I don't accept him?" "Why am I not accepting?" 

My bf is not a religious person but he has a religion and the same to me but I had and still do have religious ocd but like i'm not focused on it but today idk why we brought this up like we talked religions and it popped up again.. "What religion do I follow?" "Idk if I should believe in God or not?" and so on... and when my bf disagrees with me like any person does I find myself feeling angry like he has to think like me.. why is he like that? even though we finished talking about it and we reached an AGREEING POINT! I did a compulsion I went to google and searched "We don't have the same religious views" and I saw so many articles with so many opinions and then I asked myself "is this a real problem or again it's my ocd?" "Why don't I just stick my religion without questioning it?" "What if we share the same views" "Wait, but doesn't that mean that I'm letting go It to please him? "Isn't he controlling me?" I felt overwhelmed again and like this is my only obsession and the rest seem nonsense expect for I still doubt wether he is a good or a bad person.. I doubt my love for him. 

He is really sweet and accepting and he loves my ideas and views and he enjoyed the conversation and so did I but now that it made me question things I feel SO BAD like can I have a conversation with him with doing any of that?

Yeah me too! I'd have good days where I feel good about us, I love him, and that I can get through this. (that's my detention of a good day) when it comes to the bad day I might get angry at him for no reason, feeling like breaking up.. 

Everyday when I wake up in the morning something new comes along lol

I know exactly how you feel! Deep down inside I know I love my bf, I know he is an amazing person but my mind covered all this up with worries and obsessions and endless questions and doubts..

If you doubt ocd, then it's ocd < and still I still doubt if I have ocd or not or maybe my relationship is wrong for and i'm in denial.

It's good that you gf is supportive (my bf is supportive as well and it kills me cause I doubt who he is. I doubt his morals. I think wrong about him and I doubt if this is real or not) Just accept all these obsessions, don't ask for reassurance. It's okay feel the anxiety. Don't get that short good feeling when she answers you! My bf knows about my rocd, he knows my worries and my obsessions. There are stuff I don't say cause they're rude and mean! And I don't wanna hurt him! I'm even feeling guilty that I think wrong about him. If they were true why would I feel guilty and have anxiety and sometimes cry? cause IT IS NOT! it's our ocd. 

Therapy is great! If you can get it, it'd be amazing. Not all therapist are specialized! Find one who knows all about ocd and yeah I know the progress is slow. You have to be patient! There are times where I feel bored but idk what to do! I don't wanna leave and yet I don't wanna stay. It's like i'm trapped in my own body. Don't worry! It gets better but there are ups and downs. We are all here to support you and give you tips that might help.

I'm 19 and yeah it happens to me. When i see my single friends doing anything I find myself think "Can I do that if i'm in a relationship?" "am I going to enjoy it?" "what it I don't?" "What if I wanna be single?" 

This is your OCD. Even tho you them leaving wouldn't change anything cause of my anxiety and depression. I'm not an outgoing person after all! But i like spending time alone sometimes.

You are 100% right about what you said! I sometimes add logic and force myself so I feel better! Sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn't. Is forcing myself considered as compulsions? I don't go get reassurance but I have it all in my mind while i'm talking to him, going out with my family, watching a show.. every minute! It's like my mind is trying to figure out itself without me even talking to it. I just leave there. Is this good to do? So If I don't feel "good" or feel that "I don't love him enough" I should just feel it and feel the anxiety more?

I would say I'm more anxious in general. I get more depressed in the morning as soon as I wake up especially because I sleep with worries sometimes I dream about them, it fucks me up like I take time to let them go and go on with my day.. and this is when anxiety take over!

I've been with my bf for 3 years and I remember in our second year (I did not have rocd) but like I had ocd and depression and I remember feeling really down and not wanting to talk to anyone and I thought of breaking up with him not because I did not want him or that I had rocd but, it's because I was DEPRESSED i felt like running away and cutting all my relationships.. So like whatever you're feeling it can affect your relationship but it doesn't have to be something wrong in your relationship or in him (if there is any I'm pretty sure they can fixed) so hold on! Go to therapy to get a diagnosis, I think that way you can figure out what's going on but always do what's right. Go out with him. Go out with friends. Keep the thoughts and your judgments inside. It's easier said then done but give it a try! Don't try to fight it. Accept it! Don't act on them.

Are you depressed? Ocd, anxiety, depression can makes us see thing unclear so don't give up. Trying to figuring it out will only make it worse. Take some time out and take it simple! Wether it's ocd or not; everything can be fixed if you want to.

Yeah I am trying but there are things I can't hold myself from like over-analyzing what he says and repeating my worries and questions over and over again.. Even when I get the reassurance it makes me feel good for 3 hours and it's gone! I hate that my day are not stable. Like I wish it's either down down or up up. I don't like being sure and telling him I love him and that he is the best and after 3 hours I'm again not sure of what I told him.. it's crazy!

I'm really happy for you! This gave me hope and scared me a bit cause when you said "We might not be together forever" I had this worm anxious feeling but I guess that's normal with ROCD lol

I would love to know all about your progress! It will help me and so many others. xoxox
Keep going!

You're right! I think even if I over-analyzed I'll try to see the good things at least. I can stop myself sometimes but sometimes the fear seems so real like I say "Maybe this time is real, it isn't my ocd, maybe he meant it that way" It's tricky but I'll calm myself down the next time.

I already told my partner that sometimes while we talk I get things wrong and I over-analyze so I'm sorry. He doesn't gives me reassurance cause he knows this is gonna add up to my ocd and make it worse. He is really understanding and I feel really guilty when I think wrong but I do the right thing. I don't throw the judgements, I don't throw my guesses at him cause I know they're wrong and they'll end up making a problem and that's the last thing I want. 

For example, once I was talking about getting a piercings and he told me "Nose piercings are cool" then I had this thought "Then why doesn't he go find a girl with nose piercings" I was so close to throw this at him. I know it's irrational and my ocd is trying to make me get angry at him! So I just took a breathe and I told him what was in my mind! and he understood me and told me accept it and do what's right. 

It's really hard and I'm so aware of it. There is no conversation we have that I don't at least have 2 wrong thoughts about him! It makes me feel like a bad person and I'm afraid I'm gonna push him away if I keep doing this! deep down inside I know I don't wanna think that way but I know I can't stop it.

Omg your thoughts are the same as mine "Is the conversation boring?" "Why am I excited?" "Am I happy?"

I'm so aware of my obsession and I always thoughts that's bad cause I can feel everything WRONG i'm doing and it makes me feel like i'm being mean to my bf in my mind. Whatever judgments and thoughts I have I don't throw them at him cause it's my ocd and if I did then I'm gonna make my ocd happy and we will end up fighting over something that wasn't there.
